title: TCG:SAS-157

objectives.text:
Put 1 Golden Idol each into zones 1 and 5. 

 At the end of each round, each player scores 1 point for each of their heroes in zone 3, 2 points for each of their heroes in zone 4, and 3 points for each of their heroes in zone 5. 

 At the end of round 7, the player with the most points wins.
